messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: [P1] service=inference-queue severity=critical - queue_depth=2150, p95_latency=1.9s, p99_latency=2.8s. Autoscaler lagging. PD: https://pd/redwood/INC12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC12345 created and routed to schedule 'eng-oncall'. Page ID: pd-0xabc.

jordan.oncall: acked on PD. I'm taking it. @sre_ana can you grab metrics/cluster events? I'll check autoscaler and node events.

alex_m: Seeing a sharp traffic spike from batch-ingest jobs at ~12:03UTC, concurrent requests +180%. Processing rate dropped ~35%. Backlog rising since 12:02.

sre_ana: autoscaler logs show repeated provisioning timeouts: cloud provider returned InsufficientCapacity for spot pool. HPA thinks it scaled but nodes not registering. `kubectl get nodes` shows no new nodes. Events: `FailedCreate: InsufficientInstances` from cloud-autoscaler.

ops_ash: Confirmed: ASG spin-up requests are getting throttled by our provider region quota. AWS response excerpt: 
```
RequestLimitExceeded: You have exceeded your quota for running On-Demand instances in us-west-2
```
We recently lowered on-demand fallback flag; spot exhaustion + reduced on-demand quota = nothing comes up.

jordan.oncall: plan: 1) bump on-demand fallback & start manual scale for inference-workers 2) open a support ticket with cloud provider 3) route non-critical traffic to eu-west. Starting manual actions now.

eng-sam: For routing: we can flip read-only / embedding routes to eu-west first. We'll keep auth+PII in prod-us. I'll jot down the cutover steps.

jordan.oncall: Running manual scale:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=60
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-worker
```
Manual scale requested at 12:12UTC. If pods stuck Pending, we'll try to force on-demand pool.

alex_m: After scale request, new pods stuck in Pending with "0/3 nodes are available: Insufficient cpu". Looks like nodes didn't come up.

sre_ana: Workaround: enable on-demand fallback for the ASG now. ops_ash can flip the flag? This should bypass spot pool and use on-demand capacity.

ops_ash: flipping on-demand fallback now. Command: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name rg-inference-spots --mixed-instances-policy ...` (doing it via console for speed). ETA ~2m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: escalation threshold 10m — if no reduction in queue, escalate to SRE rotation lead.

product-liz: Support: customers A and B reporting "service slow" and some 503s for embedding endpoints. I'm drafting an external status update to send in 15 minutes.

oncall_next: (cc) I'm the next oncall starting in 35m, available for handoff.

ops_ash: on-demand fallback toggled at 12:16UTC. ASG requests for on-demand started. Cloud returned acceptance.

alex_m: nodes coming up, pods scheduling. 30/60 new worker pods started, processing rate climbed ~25%. queue depth now 1640 and falling.

jordan.oncall: good. keep eyes on p99. I'll keep manual replicas at 60 while we watch warmup. We might need to keep slightly above baseline to clear backlog faster.

sre_ana: Observed longer KV cache warmup causing higher per-request CPU while caches repopulate. This explains why scaling doesn't immediately reduce latency. Consider prioritized warmup strategy (prefix caching) in runbook.

alex_m: Running warmup job for top prefixes now (script: `scripts/warmup_prefixes.sh --top 200`).

product-liz: Status update posted to customers: "We are experiencing degraded inference throughput in US region; mitigation in progress. Some requests may be slower. No data exposure." Link: https://status.redwood/INC12345-stats :information_source:

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: acknowledged by jordan.oncall (12:13UTC). Next escalation will occur at 12:23UTC if unresolved.

jordan.oncall: After manual scale + on-demand fallback + warmup, queue draining pace steady. p99 down to 1.6s. Keep monitoring for 15m.

ops_ash: Cloud support ticket opened: ticket# CS-98765 (quota limit). They confirmed a temporary quota increase request, estimate 30-60m.

eng-sam: Routing change: non-critical embedding traffic started shifting to eu-west at 12:24UTC. Will stop after backlog is clear.

alex_m: Queue now 820 -> 560 in last 6 minutes. Errors back to baseline for most customers.

sre_ana: Next steps (runbook): 1) keep manual replicas until queue <200 2) follow up with infra to request permanent on-demand fallback policy for this pool 3) evaluate moving critical warmup to prefetch layer 4) schedule post-incident blameless postmortem.

jordan.oncall: Handoff: I'm handing over to @oncall_next at 12:45UTC. Summary for next: cause=spot exhaustion + on-demand quota low -> autoscaler unable to provision; mitigations applied=on-demand fallback toggle + manual scale + warmup + routing; customer impact=degraded throughput and transient 5xx for embedding endpoints; current state=draining, p99 1.5s, queue 210.

oncall_next: acked. I'll take over and keep watch until fully cleared. Please add any logs or links to the incident doc.

ops_ash: Added incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC12345 and included relevant cloud logs + ASG activity.

jordan.oncall: final note: we should add a preflight to raise on-demand fallback thresholds automatically when spot failure rates exceed X% — we'll include that as action item in postmortem. Good work everyone :thumbsup:
